headlines.title: Pennsylvania woman dies from measles complications, state’s third death this year
headlines.description: The 40-year-old woman died as the U.S. experiences its worst outbreak of the disease in 35 years.

headlines.title: Why are Americans so tired so often? New CDC report highlights who’s feeling it most
headlines.description: About 71% of of adults in the U.S. say they experience fatigue, a new report from the CDC found. Women and younger adults are feeling it most often.

headlines.title: A Look at the Health Toll of 9/11, 25 Years After the Attacks
headlines.description: The attacks of Sept. 11 have been a rolling tragedy in the quarter-century since the towers fell, with thousands more people dying from the air they breathed in and around the toxic pile at ground zero. As the country prepared to mark the 25thanniversary, New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani released a trove of previously undisclosed government documents showing just how deadly the air was. NBC’s Valerie Castro reports in this week’s Sunday Focus.

headlines.title: FBI agent died of cancer after 9/11 Pentagon response. His widow is now telling his story
headlines.description: NBC News' Monica Alba sits down with the widow of an FBI agent Jack Hess, who developed stage four cancer after responding to the Pentagon on 9/11. She shares his story and the ripple effects the attack still has 25 years later.

headlines.title: How to Reset Your Routine for Fall to Create Healthy Habits
headlines.description: School is back in session and life is getting back to normal, so psychotherapist Niro Feliciano stops by TODAY to share tips for resetting your routine. See her advice for dealing with shorter daylight hours and packed schedules, which includes “progress over perfection,” limiting phone use, going for walks, and more.

headlines.title: 9/11 survivors are being diagnosed with cancer 25 years after the attacks
headlines.description: Doctors at the World Trade Center Health Program say they are now seeing a surge in 9/11-related cancer cases. NBC News' Erika Edwards speaks to Lisa Parker and Frank Kotnik about their health journeys since that tragic day.

headlines.title: Get 30% off this popular sunrise alarm clock
headlines.description: Save 30% on the Philips SmartSleep Wake-Up Light, a clinically proven sunrise alarm clock that helps you wake up gently as mornings get darker this fall.

headlines.title: Bar soaps vs. body wash — which is best for your skin?
headlines.description: Bar soaps work as effectively as body washes and I rounded up editor-approved picks from Dove, L’Occitane, Avène and more.

headlines.title: Sale alert: Save up to 30% off Nintendo games, accessories and more
headlines.description: Nintendo’s Customer Appreciation Sale runs Sept. 13–26, cutting 30% off dozens of Switch digital games and bundles, plus deals on accessories, Amiibo and apparel.

headlines.title: If you brush and floss, do you really need mouthwash? Here’s what dentists say
headlines.description: Looking for a dentist-approved mouthwash? Experts recommend top options for fresh breath and healthy gums.

headlines.title: Your health insurance bills are about to go up
headlines.description: Most Americans can expect to pay significantly more each month for health insurance next year, whether they get it through work, the Affordable Care Act or Medicare.

headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.
